subtopics.label: Membrane Protein Structure and Function
subtopics.description: Structural and functional studies of integral membrane proteins including ion channels, transporters, GPCRs, and scramblases using cryo-EM, high-speed AFM, NMR, and molecular dynamics simulations to elucidate mechanisms of gating, transport, and lipid interactions at atomic resolution.
subtopics.short_description: Atomic-resolution studies of ion channels, transporters, and GPCRs using cryo-EM, NMR, and molecular dynamics.

subtopics.label: Cryo-EM and High-Resolution Structural Biology of Macromolecular Complexes
subtopics.description: Cryo-EM and related structural approaches to determine atomic-resolution structures of macromolecular complexes including motor proteins, chromatin remodelers, cell wall synthesis machinery, and signaling complexes, revealing mechanisms of assembly, activation, and regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Atomic-resolution cryo-EM structures of motor proteins, chromatin remodelers, and signaling complexes.

subtopics.label: Lipid Biology, Sphingolipid Metabolism, and Membrane Lipid Dynamics
subtopics.description: Biochemical and functional studies of lipid metabolism including sphingolipid synthesis, cholesterol transport and homeostasis, phospholipid scrambling, and fatty acid metabolism, with emphasis on their roles in cardiovascular disease, cancer, and cellular signaling.
subtopics.short_description: Sphingolipid synthesis, cholesterol transport, and phospholipid metabolism in cardiovascular disease and cancer.

subtopics.label: RNA Modifications, m6A Epitranscriptomics, and RNA Biology
subtopics.description: Studies of post-transcriptional RNA modifications, particularly N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and related modifications, including their deposition, recognition by reader proteins, effects on mRNA stability and translation, and roles in stress responses and disease.
subtopics.short_description: m6A and related post-transcriptional RNA modifications governing mRNA stability, translation, and stress responses.

subtopics.label: NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Bioenergetics, and Cellular Energy
subtopics.description: Biochemical studies of NAD+/NADH metabolism, mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy homeostasis, including enzyme kinetics, metabolic flux analysis, and therapeutic targeting of bioenergetic pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Enzyme kinetics and metabolic flux of NAD+/NADH pathways and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation.

subtopics.label: Protein Structure, Aggregation, and Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Structural and biophysical characterization of proteins involved in neurodegenerative diseases including tau, alpha-synuclein, amyloid-beta, and BDNF, examining post-translational modifications, aggregation mechanisms, membrane interactions, and synaptic function.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biophysical characterization of tau, alpha-synuclein, and amyloid-beta aggregation mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Soluble Adenylyl Cyclase, cAMP Signaling, and Contraception
subtopics.description: Biochemical and pharmacological studies of soluble adenylyl cyclase (sAC/ADCY10) including its activation by bicarbonate, inhibitor development for male contraception, roles in sperm function, melanin synthesis, and cAMP microdomain signaling.
subtopics.short_description: Soluble adenylyl cyclase biochemistry, inhibitor development for male contraception, and cAMP microdomain signaling.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Drug Discovery and Target Engagement
subtopics.description: Discovery, optimization, and biophysical characterization of small molecule inhibitors and modulators targeting immune checkpoints (LAG-3, ICOS, TIM-3, VISTA), proteasomes, kinases, and other therapeutic targets using high-throughput screening, structure-activity relationships, and biochemical assays.
subtopics.short_description: High-throughput screening and structure-activity optimization of inhibitors targeting immune checkpoints and kinases.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Biochemistry and Drug Targets
subtopics.description: Biochemical and structural studies of Mycobacterium tuberculosis enzymes and metabolic pathways including cell wall biosynthesis, NAD metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, proteasome function, and redox biology, with emphasis on identifying and validating novel drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biochemical studies of TB metabolic pathways to identify and validate novel therapeutic targets.

subtopics.label: Ion Channel Biophysics and Electrophysiology
subtopics.description: Biophysical and electrophysiological studies of voltage-gated, ligand-gated, and mechanosensitive ion channels including sodium, potassium, calcium, and chloride channels, examining gating mechanisms, pharmacology, and roles in excitability and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Gating mechanisms, pharmacology, and disease roles of voltage-gated, ligand-gated, and mechanosensitive ion channels.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics and Metabolic Profiling in Disease
subtopics.description: Untargeted and targeted metabolomics studies characterizing metabolic alterations in cancer, neurodegeneration, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and infection, using mass spectrometry and related approaches to identify biomarkers and metabolic vulnerabilities.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry-based metabolic profiling to identify biomarkers and vulnerabilities in cancer, neurodegeneration, and diabetes.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism and De Novo Lipogenesis in Cancer
subtopics.description: Biochemical studies of fatty acid synthesis, cholesterol biosynthesis, and lipid metabolic reprogramming in cancer cells, including FASN, ACC, SREBP2, and related enzymes as therapeutic targets, and the role of lipid metabolism in tumor progression and drug resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Fatty acid synthesis and cholesterol biosynthesis enzymes as therapeutic targets in tumor progression and drug resistance.

subtopics.label: DNA Replication, Repair, and Telomere Maintenance
subtopics.description: Biochemical and structural studies of DNA replication machinery, double-strand break repair, telomere maintenance proteins, and genome stability mechanisms, including studies in model organisms and human cells.
subtopics.short_description: Biochemical and structural studies of replication machinery, double-strand break repair, and genome stability.

subtopics.label: GPCR Signaling, Receptor Pharmacology, and Allosteric Regulation
subtopics.description: Structural and functional studies of G protein-coupled receptors including adrenergic receptors, metabotropic glutamate receptors, and glucagon receptors, examining activation mechanisms, G protein coupling, allosteric modulation, and pharmacological regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Activation mechanisms, G protein coupling, and allosteric modulation of adrenergic, glutamate, and glucagon receptors.

subtopics.label: Synaptic Vesicle Biology and Neurotransmitter Release
subtopics.description: Biochemical and biophysical studies of synaptic vesicle proteins including Munc13, complexin, alpha-synuclein, and SNARE complexes, examining mechanisms of vesicle docking, priming, fusion, and neurotransmitter release.
subtopics.short_description: SNARE complex and Munc13-mediated vesicle docking, priming, and fusion underlying neurotransmitter release.

subtopics.label: Chromatin Regulation, Epigenetic Dysregulation, and Lymphomagenesis
subtopics.description: Research on how chromatin-modifying complexes (cohesin, PRC1/2, histone variants, HDAC, SETD2, ARID1A) and epigenetic regulators drive B-cell lymphoma development, germinal center biology, and transcriptional reprogramming in hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic dysregulation by chromatin-modifying complexes driving B-cell lymphoma and germinal center biology.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation, CDK Activity, and Proliferation Control
subtopics.description: Studies examining CDK4/6 signaling, G1 phase commitment, cell cycle entry and exit under stress, and the molecular mechanisms by which cyclin-dependent kinases control proliferation in normal and cancer cells.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 signaling, G1 phase commitment, and cyclin-dependent kinase mechanisms in normal and cancer cell proliferation.

subtopics.label: Glucose Transport, GLUT Biology, and Metabolic Disease
subtopics.description: Research on GLUT1/GLUT4 transporter biology, glucose homeostasis, insulin signaling, and therapeutic strategies for glucose transporter deficiency syndromes and type 2 diabetes, including beta-cell function and pancreatic islet biology.
subtopics.short_description: GLUT1/GLUT4 biology, insulin signaling, and therapeutic strategies for transporter deficiency and type 2 diabetes.

subtopics.label: Extracellular Vesicles, Particles, and Cancer Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on extracellular vesicles and particles as cancer biomarkers, mediators of metabolic dysfunction, and modulators of immune responses, including their isolation, proteomic profiling, and roles in tumor progression and metastasis.
subtopics.short_description: Extracellular vesicles as cancer biomarkers and mediators of immune modulation, metabolic dysfunction, and metastasis.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation, Lipid Metabolism, and Adipose Biology
subtopics.description: Research on adipogenesis, preadipocyte differentiation, lipid handling in adipose tissue, and proteomic/metabolic characterization of adipocytes, including catecholamine-driven lipolysis and UHRF1-mediated regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Adipogenesis, lipolysis, and proteomic characterization of lipid metabolism in adipose tissue biology.

subtopics.label: Innate Immune Signaling, Inflammasome Activation, and Inflammatory Pathways
subtopics.description: Studies on NLRP3 inflammasome activation, caspase-11 interactions, necroptosis via RIPK3/MLKL, macrophage programming by cytokines, and innate immune responses to bacterial and viral pathogens.
subtopics.short_description: NLRP3 inflammasome, necroptosis via RIPK3/MLKL, and macrophage innate immune responses to pathogens.

subtopics.label: HIV-1 Antibody Responses, Vaccine Immunology, and Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies
subtopics.description: Research on broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV-1, SOSIP trimer immunogens, antibody neutralization mechanisms, glycan heterogeneity effects, and vaccine strategies to elicit protective humoral immunity.
subtopics.short_description: Broadly neutralizing antibodies, SOSIP trimer immunogens, and vaccine strategies for protective humoral immunity against HIV-1.

subtopics.label: Cytomegalovirus Glycoprotein B Antibodies and Vaccine Development
subtopics.description: Studies on antibody responses to cytomegalovirus glycoprotein B (gB), vaccine-elicited versus natural infection antibody profiles, and the development of CMV vaccines targeting gB epitopes.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody responses to cytomegalovirus glycoprotein B and vaccine strategies targeting gB epitopes.

subtopics.label: Influenza Antibody Responses, Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies, and Vaccine Antigens
subtopics.description: Research on broadly neutralizing antibodies targeting conserved influenza epitopes (hemagglutinin anchor, stalk), polyreactive B cells, preexisting immunity effects on vaccine responses, and egg-derived glycan antigenic decoys.
subtopics.short_description: Conserved hemagglutinin epitope antibodies, preexisting immunity effects, and broadly protective influenza vaccine antigens.

subtopics.label: Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC) Regulation and Renal Sodium Transport
subtopics.description: Studies on ENaC subunit expression, ubiquitination, cleavage, aldosterone-dependent trafficking, and regulation of sodium and potassium excretion in the kidney.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial sodium channel subunit trafficking, aldosterone-dependent regulation, and renal sodium and potassium excretion.

subtopics.label: Cell Migration, Actin Cytoskeleton Dynamics, and Membrane Protrusions
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms controlling cell migration, including F-actin organization, membrane protrusion dynamics, fascin and T-plastin function, RhoC/ROCK signaling, and ER-PM contact gradients directing motility.
subtopics.short_description: F-actin organization, membrane protrusion dynamics, and RhoC/ROCK signaling controlling directed cell motility.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle-Based Drug Delivery, Theranostics, and Targeted Cancer Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on ultrasmall silica nanoparticles, peptide nanofibers, and targeted ligands (PSMA, FAP-α) for cancer drug delivery, imaging, and theranostic applications in prostate, lung, gastric, and other cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Ultrasmall silica nanoparticles and targeted ligands for cancer imaging, drug delivery, and theranostic applications.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Antigenic Variation, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on Plasmodium falciparum antigenic variation, var gene switching, histone methyltransferase roles, and the metabolic and epigenetic regulation of sexual differentiation in malaria parasites.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium falciparum var gene switching, histone methyltransferase roles, and epigenetic control of sexual differentiation.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Antibody Responses, Antiviral Strategies, and COVID-19 Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on broadly neutralizing antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 variants, antiviral drug identification, organoid models of infection, and molecular mechanisms of viral entry and immune evasion.
subtopics.short_description: Broadly neutralizing antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 variants, antiviral drug identification, and viral entry mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Membrane Biophysics, Lipid-Protein Interactions, and Vesicle Dynamics
subtopics.description: Biophysical studies on lipid-protein interactions at membranes, including clathrin lattice mechanics, annexin-lipid interactions, phospholipid scrambling, VDAC-mediated phospholipid import, StarD4 sterol trafficking, and high-speed AFM imaging of membrane protein dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Clathrin mechanics, annexin-lipid binding, phospholipid scrambling, and sterol trafficking at biological membranes.
